text:
incident-bot: PAGE -> P1: ganymede-8k high tail latency (prod). Trigger: 99p latency > 2s for 5m. Notifying on-call @ashley_oncall.

ashley_oncall: on it, looking at dashboards now.

ashley_oncall: quick snapshot — 99p = 2.8s, error rate up ~0.5pp, overall TPM spiked ~2.5x in the last 10m. Large embedding jobs from tenant acme-inc visible.

raj_sre: can we do a per-model throttle for ganymede-8k and push overflow to merlin-14b? also consider disabling function-calls for that model family to reduce compute per request.

marta_runtime: agree. I'll do a surgical TPM cut first to avoid broad capacity churn.

marta_runtime: executing change now:
```bash
# reduce per-model TPM for ganymede-8k
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood/api/v1/quotas 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' 
  -d '{"model":"ganymede-8k","tpm":300,"reason":"live mitigation - high tail latency"}'
```

incident-bot: QUOTA UPDATE applied by marta_runtime — ganymede-8k tpm: 1200 -> 300.

kim_prodops: FYI this will generate 429s for heavy acme-inc traffic. Notifying account team. @leo_support please ping ACME.

leo_support: pinged ACME (email + slack). Sent short note: "We're doing a temporary traffic sculpt on ganymede-8k to restore latency. You may see 429s; route-based fallback to merlin-14b available, we can help switch routes."

marta_runtime: also disabling function-calls on ganymede-8k to trim per-request work while sculpt is active:
```json
{ "model":"ganymede-8k", "feature_flags": {"function_calling": false}, "reason": "live mitigation" }
```

incident-bot: FEATURE FLAG updated by marta_runtime — function_calling=false for ganymede-8k.

ashley_oncall: metrics update ~5m after changes — 99p latency down to ~1.1s, error rate back to baseline, TPM observed ~310. Looks stable so far.

raj_sre: nice. Plan: keep this sculpt for 60m, then small canary increases: +100 TPM every 15m if 99p stays <1.5s and error rate <0.2%. If any regression, revert to 300 TPM and reinstate function_calling=false.

kim_prodops: I'll coordinate comms and post a short status to #status-dashboard. Also flag to Account Ops for possible credits.

ashley_oncall: documenting handoff: monitoring window 60m, escalation path to raj_sre (pager) and marta_runtime for quota flips. I'll hand to kim_prodops in 30m.

leo_support: ACME replied — they prefer automatic fallback to merlin-14b; asked for ETA. I told them 1h and we'll follow up.

marta_runtime: putting the exact commands in runbook for the next oncall:
```bash
# to increase by 100 TPM
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood/api/v1/quotas -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' -d '{"model":"ganymede-8k","tpm":{{new_tpm}},"reason":"canary bump"}'

# to re-enable function calls
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood/api/v1/featureflags -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' -d '{"model":"ganymede-8k","feature_flags":{"function_calling": true}}'
```

ashley_oncall: handing off now to kim_prodops for next 30m watch. I'll remain available if we need escalation.

kim_prodops: ack — taking watch. Will post periodic updates.

incident-bot: INCIDENT -> status updated: mitigation in place (per-model TPM sculpt + function_calling disabled).

marta_runtime: closing active remediation thread, transitioning to monitoring notes in the incident doc.

ashley_oncall: thanks team :thumbsup:
